technical.summary: MO shows solid bullish structure with price above all major MAs and ADX trending, but lacks fresh momentum signals; RSI elevated without rising, conflicting MACD signals, and absence of triggered entries suggest caution on new long positions.

fundamental.summary: MO shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying data, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 3 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral overall signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds (crisis VIX, flat yield curve, rising dollar) combined with critical earnings binary event in 3 days create elevated risk environment for MO.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with ADX trending and bullish DI alignment provides structural support, while extreme fear sentiment offers contrarian entry opportunity near support at 40.128.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary in 3 days combined with crisis-level VIX, macro headwinds, RSI overbought without momentum confirmation, conflicting MACD signals, and zero fundamental conviction create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: While price structure remains bullish above major MAs and extreme fear sentiment offers contrarian opportunity, the critical earnings binary in 3 days combined with crisis-level macro conditions creates unacceptable risk/reward asymmetry for new swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 3 days presents binary volatility event that could gap through technical support levels regardless of chart structure, amplified by elevated VIX and macro headwinds.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk despite bullish technicals
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MO position with 13 existing Consumer Staples positions (8.2% sector concentration); adding exposure increases concentration risk without fundamental conviction to justify it.
